newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bourse closes mixed in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bourse closes mixed in active trade.

text.p: Morocco's stock exchange index was stagnant on Tuesday despite active trading in market blue-chip firms, traders said. The bourse all-share index closed at 654.58 points compared with 654.59 on Monday, a bourse official said.

"The bourse index slightly stagnated on Tuesday...But it will soon resume its upward trend as investors expect an active trading on the market this summer compared with last year," a stockbroker said.
Trading on the official market jumped to 70.3 million dirhams from 12.6 million on Monday, the broker said.
Total exchanges on the OTC and official market rose to 74.6 million dirhams from 51.5 million on the previous session.
Wafabank and steel giant Sonasid, gained 16 dirhams to close respectively at 861 and 569 dirhams while largest conglomerate ONA Group fell three dirhams to 832 dirhams.
Morocco's largest oil refinery Samir dropped 9.15 dirhams to 330 dirhams.
No explanation was given by Bourse officials on Samir's drop at a time investors expect the firm's shares to surge.
